rule: A stream goes live only when its one test on data it never saw has at least 50 signals, earns at least +0.05R per signal after real costs, has a profit factor of at least 1.1 and a drawdown smaller than half of its total result.

crypto_15m.reason: Switched off (Nov 2026).
